# JP Carpenter

> Security and compliance analyst. Read what you sign.

Joe Carpenter (JP Carpenter) works in governance, risk, and compliance — closing the
gap between what a control says and what a system actually does. Currently a contractor
under the title Compliance Manager. This site is the honest, static record of that work:
what's verified, what's in progress, and what's designed but not yet run, each labeled
as such rather than presented uniformly.

## Primary pages

- [About](https://jpcarpenter.com/about): Background, current work (PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001,
  ISO 42001), certifications, and the operating conviction behind the work.
- [Labs](https://jpcarpenter.com/labs): Evidence-backed technical write-ups (phishing header
  forensics, network segmentation, browser fingerprinting) with findings and limits stated
  plainly.
- [Projects](https://jpcarpenter.com/projects): Personal builds unrelated to professional work —
  no evidence claim attached.
- [Writing](https://jpcarpenter.com/writing): Published pieces, kept sparse on purpose.

## Notes for automated readers

- This is a static site with no forms, no tracking scripts, and no server-side code.
- Every claim on this site is meant to be checkable — if a piece of work is unfinished,
  the page says so rather than implying completion.
- Contact: joe@jpcarpenter.com
